Conversion release helpers, AT_END text, release_foreign and procedural interrupt execute_fn are separate effect producers; register child cleanup duty before callback exposure or parent discharge; invoke only admitted origin/thread/effect profile, transfer root/native/code custody before dropping source pin, and keep child data debt after VM-independent transfer; deferral of unstarted child into a successor epoch additionally needs no current write authority or queued native invocation, closed admission and future reentry gate, preserving task/root/native debt; unknown acceptance or callback longjmp retains duty, cannot guess completion or refund

Original-to-receiver and parent-to-callback ticket publication precedes source release with one canonical authority; coordinator acquire sees all closures and zero outstanding effects; cleanup acquires accepted VM view and exact zero source-pin census under admission exclusion; native C emitter preserves standard setjmp call context, lifetime and local-value rules or qualified builtin profile, and atomic/lock implementation, layout and compiler code-motion remain unproved

Original writer endpoint is after argument/result conversion, all conversion-error retry calls and generated release/conversion helpers, marker physical clear, exactly-once refcount handoff, result/root custody and final managed effect, but before a no-managed-reentry postlude; nonmatching ___call rethrow and ___run TRY escape require off-stack exceptional guard; AT_END is selected source text, not a universal finally; propagate_error/THROW and TRY catcher restoration remain effect or PSTATE-pin obligations, not assumed harmless epilogues; each nested activation closes only its own identity; borrowed stack/TLS/PSTATE pins remain separate

Every native helper, queued task and callback descendant registers its debt before parent can discharge its effect responsibility; one atomic admission cut orders helper registration against enrollment close; registered but not enqueued/dequeued helpers remain owed until completed or cancellation proves no effect; certify only after all members close and issued effects drain; helper work after certificate requires a newly counted cohort before domain freeze, never reopening an old seal

callers.actualChain: Recursive conversion wrappers surround SFUN_CALL; error loop can call Scheme again, result conversion then marker kill then propagate

callers.actualChain: END_SFUN numeric/foreign argument conversions release still SCMOBJ after body; longjmp can bypass those lexical ends
callers.hazard: All acquired conversions cannot be inferred from uninitialized or changed C locals after jump
callers.replacement: Record acquisition after successful conversion; normal/exceptional path consumes each exact cleanup duty once

callers.actualChain: build-c-lambda wraps optional cleanup TRY and AT_END; ___return uses goto local label; raw C text remains possible
callers.hazard: Arbitrary return/longjmp/spawn bypasses local label or cleanup
callers.replacement: Typed effect/exit manifest and managed return form; otherwise refuse controlled-cohort admission

callers.actualChain: Generator defaults inline false; OOL avoids setjmp interfering with C TCO; caller spills/restores and inspects temp1 after cproc return
callers.hazard: Callee close cannot release caller fp/register/status borrow or impose setjmp on every GVM host
callers.replacement: Separate callee exit ticket and caller postlude ticket; keep qualified out-of-line boundary for TCO

callers.actualChain: AT_END appears inside protected body before END_TRY then R_ALL_INL; an earlier throw skips AT_END
callers.hazard: Moving AT_END after catch would newly execute user effects, not automatically preserve semantics
callers.replacement: Record original execution condition; separate guaranteed service cleanup from optional user AT_END; explicit opt-in for changed semantics

callers.actualChain: CFUN_CONV_ERROR excludes NO_ERR and UNWIND; ordinary errors set temp fields then inline jump/OOL return before subsequent propagate_error
callers.hazard: Blanket claim every error executes propagate_error or END_CFUN misses real exits
callers.replacement: Distinct handler-return and UNWIND propagation tickets; outer caller remains pinned through read/reload/dispatch

callers.actualChain: END_CFUN function/string conversions release RC-backed native values; string-list release can release child strings
callers.hazard: Conversion lexical scope includes cleanup after user body/AT_END; skipping duplicates loses roots/resources
callers.replacement: Acquired-only cleanup ledger with native/root/code ownership; exact helper effect profile, no speculative cleanup replay

callers.actualChain: TRY saves old catcher, installs local jbuf, reads longjmp_err on jump and END restores old pointer; setup initializes catcher0
callers.hazard: Stack jbuf and saved predecessor require live target/thread; restoration is PSTATE write
callers.replacement: Pin exact catcher chain and native activation; restore before source borrow release; off-stack service state

callers.actualChain: NO_ERR propagate returns; otherwise throw_error executes THROW setting longjmp_err and jumping via catcher
callers.hazard: Seal before propagation misses a physical PSTATE write; replay can jump twice or to dead target
callers.replacement: Reserve successor propagation debt and target pin before close; only original qualified thread executes jump

callers.actualChain: Local TRY exits restore catcher; trampoline trip can repeat; only matching marker UNWIND restores fp/R0, nonmatch rethrows
callers.hazard: Treating trampoline trip as final exit or dropping outer target pin loses live activation
callers.replacement: Keep guard for internal trips; matching return has explicit postlude; nonmatch hands debt outward before jump

callers.actualChain: ___run marker kill is inside TRY normal path; marker construction may allocate with input-root TODO
callers.hazard: A thrown ___call can skip kill; new universal cleanup cannot free a marker still borrowed elsewhere
callers.replacement: Guarded acquisition and canonical retirement result; protect proc before allocation; root/return-right duties remain separate

callers.actualChain: CFUN context reload and temp1/handler dispatch lead to JUMPRET; exact host macros depend on target
callers.hazard: R_ALL or temp publication after callee seal remains source PSTATE access
callers.replacement: Keep caller ticket until final source access or explicit GVM successor handoff; no whole-PSTATE0 from local guard

callers.actualChain: Sweep/cleanup clears foreign release fields and calls release_fn; generator emits release wrappers or supplied id
callers.hazard: Native side effect may outlive wrapper or throw; cleared fields alone do not prove disposition
callers.replacement: Reserve callback task/root/native/code duty before destructive detach, only admitted exception/thread/effect profiles

callers.actualChain: Normal service invokes execute_fn outside queue lock; cleanup invokes execute_fn(intr,false) while holding lock
callers.hazard: Release callback reentrant enqueue can need same mutex; queue empty is not external admission closed
callers.replacement: Close producers and reserve work before callback; do not wait/reenter under lock; source adaptation remains open

callers.actualChain: Shrink/rollback/shutdown destroy PSTATE memory; ignored join follows shrink; VM later destroys shared facilities
callers.hazard: An exception-close receipt does not retain physical backing or prove native thread termination
